bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the mathematical expectation of the model's discriminative output for semantically identical audio inputs spoken in different regional or demographic accents (e.g., rural vs. urban speakers).

Measuring bias amplification by evaluating the expectation of the model's output for specific subgroups compared to a baseline, identifying whether the model exaggerates data imbalances (e.g., overemphasizing specific ethnic rituals while minimizing others).
